notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 91–145, Dec. 12, 1969, 83 Stat. 340; Pub. L. 91–382, Aug. 18, 1970, 84 Stat. 807, provided for appointment and salary of a Comptroller of the Senate and a secretary to the Comptroller.
Effective Date of RepealPub. L. 93–145 provided that the repeal is effective July 1, 1973.
